messages:
auditor_kim: Hi team — auditors need an evidence bundle tying RBAC edits (k8s RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding + IAM policy commits) to KMS activity (Decrypt / GenerateDataKey / ReEncrypt) for 2025-10-10T00:00Z → 2025-10-13T00:00Z. Need signed manifest + per-file SHA256 and a short control map to SOC2/ISO.

rebecca: We can deliver. Clarify: include admin-console and terraform runs? EKM optional. Also prefer a single consolidated bundle across prod regions.

auditor_kim: Yes include admin-console + terraform. KMS-signed manifest preferred. Provide raw CSVs and a redacted set.

sam: Quick plan: 1) export CloudTrail for eventName in (Decrypt, GenerateDataKey, ReEncrypt, CreateGrant), 2) k8s audit for rolebinding/clusterrolebinding create/patch/delete, 3) admin_ui audit + terraform_runs, 4) produce correlation.csv joining RBAC changes to KMS events and compute correlation_score.

sam: Splunk snippets I'll run (prod):
```spl
index=cloudtrail (eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey OR eventName=ReEncrypt OR eventName=CreateGrant)
| eval ts=_time
| table ts, eventName, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters.keyId, requestParameters.keyAlias, sourceIPAddress, userAgent
| sort ts
```
```spl
index=k8s_audit (objectRef.resource=rolebindings OR objectRef.resource=clusterrolebindings)
| table _time, user.username, verb, objectRef.resource, objectRef.name, requestObject
```

rebecca: Correlation rules (documented): time_delta (default +/- 3m, weight 40), token_issuer/OIDC sub match (30), IP+userAgent match (20), infra/admin reference (10). We'll normalize scores to 0..1 and include pseudocode in scoring_rules.md.

auditor_kim: Important: flag any ephemeral key usage (aliases like alias/ephemeral/*), CreateGrant events, and annotate rows for INC-20251011-5 (autoscaler rollback during window).

sam: Staging (unsigned) bundle: s3://redwood-compliance/temp/1943210000-rbac-kms-bundle.zip — contents: cloudtrail.csv, k8s_audit.csv, admin_ui.csv, terraform_runs.csv, correlation.csv, scoring_rules.md, control_map.md, README.md, manifest.json. After computing per-file SHA256 we'll sign manifest.json with KMS (alias/audit-sign) and move to s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1943210000/.

evidence-bot: INCIDENT 2025-10-11T02:18Z - autoscaler rollback detected. ID: INC-20251011-5

rebecca: Example sanitized row we'll include in README (emails redacted, ids truncated):
"rbac_1732100001 | frank[at]redwood (redacted) | RoleBinding:prod-autoscaler | patch | kms_1732100022 | svc-account-autoscaler | key/7e2b-xxxx | alias/ephemeral/autoscaler | 0.90 | INC-20251011-5 | s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1943210000/manifest.json.kms.sig"

auditor_kim: ETA for signed bundle? Also include retention notes: CloudTrail 180d, k8s_audit 90d, admin_ui 365d, terraform_runs 365d.

sam: ETA ~4 hours. We'll DM presigned link when signed. Will include a short control_map.md mapping each file to SOC2 CC6.* and ISO A.9/A.12 entries and include redaction rules (emails -> sha256, IP last octet masked).

auditor_kim: Thanks — we'll review on receipt and follow up if we want ekm logs. :thumbsup:
